sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The operator publishes Standard Long Track and Long Track with Chicane events, and its facility plan identifies the complete northern loop, central hairpins and southern return. This general venue configuration groups those two independently mapped lap choices, excluding the northern training shortcuts and the paddock access spur. Contemporary bus-stop alignment and historical catalogue correspondence remain draft. Shared edges count once. The independent unique branch distance is 856.6 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
